## What {shop} is
{shop} is a local classifieds noticeboard for people in Fuerteventura (things, services and wanted ads). We publish listings from third parties; buyer and seller agree on the sale directly. {shop} does not sell the listed items, does not take payment for them and is not a party to the sale.

## Liability
{shop} is a platform that only connects private buyers and sellers, like a noticeboard or a social network. We are not the seller, buyer, agent or guarantor of any item or service and are not a party to any agreement between users. {shop} therefore takes no responsibility for the items, services or deals listed (their existence, condition, quality, safety, legality, price, handover or payment) nor for the conduct of users. Buyer and seller agree, hand over and pay directly and at their own risk.
The content of each listing (description, condition, price, photos) comes from the seller. We review listings before publishing them, but we cannot guarantee they are accurate. As a hosting service provider under article 16 of the LSSI, we are not liable for this content as long as we have no actual knowledge that it is unlawful. If a listing breaks the law or your rights, write to us and we will take it down promptly.
Nothing in this notice limits rights that cannot be excluded by law.

## Intellectual property
The design, logo and texts of {shop} belong to its owner. The photos in listings belong to their sellers.
PRIVACY_TEXT_SHOWCASE:
This policy explains which personal data {shop} processes, why, and which rights you have under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and Spanish law (LOPDGDD).

## Controller
Jose Miralles, NIE Z1111174A, C. Juan Sebastián Elcano, 12, 35660 Corralejo, Las Palmas, Spain. Email: hola@baifo.es

## If you post a listing
When you write to us on WhatsApp to list something, we process your name, your WhatsApp number, the photos and what you tell us for your listing. We use them to prepare and publish your listing (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR). We improve the photos and write the text with artificial intelligence (OpenAI).
Like on a social network, you decide whether your number is shown: it only appears on the website and in the listings list if you consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR), and people see it when they tap "Contact" on your listing. Anyone interested writes to you directly, and you decide whether to reply. You can withdraw your consent at any time.
Each listing is online for at most 3 months. After that, or when you tell us it is sold, we take it down. We delete your data when you ask us to, unless a law requires us to keep it.

## If you visit the website or contact someone
To show the website, the server records technical data (IP address, page, time, browser) for security (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR) and deletes it after a short time. If you contact someone on WhatsApp or by phone, you do so directly with each other: {shop} takes no part in that conversation or in what you agree, and is not responsible for it.

## Cookies
We only use technically necessary cookies: one for your language and, for administrators, a session cookie. We do not use analytics, tracking or advertising cookies.

## Who processes data on our behalf
- Vercel Inc. (website hosting)
- Neon Inc. (database)
- UploadThing / Ping Labs Inc. (photo storage)
- OpenAI (AI photo and text improvement)
- Resend Inc. (sending emails)
- ImprovMX (forwarding emails to hola@baifo.es)
- WhatsApp / Meta Platforms Ireland (messaging)
Some of them are in the USA; these transfers rely on the EU-US Data Privacy Framework or the EU standard contractual clauses.

## Your rights
You can request access, correction, deletion, restriction, objection and portability of your data by writing to hola@baifo.es. You can also complain to the Spanish Data Protection Agency (www.aepd.es).
